answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the prism until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the reef of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
